explanation: At D1 the value is low: about 2 after a rewarded visit to S1, 0 after a rewarded visit to S2, and 2 to 6 after an unrewarded trial (usually 4 to 5 when the previous choice was a2). At GO it is 7 to 9 (9 after an unrewarded trial, 6 to 7 after a rewarded S2 visit), and at D2 it is high: 10 when a1 led rarely to S2, 8 to 9 for a common S2 or S1, about 7 for S1 right after a rewarded S2 visit, and 5 to 6 when a2 led rarely to S1.
